title: cephalaria balansae
intro: Cephalaria balansae, commonly known as Balansa's cephalaria, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Helianthus genus and is native to Western Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cephalaria balansae include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating infections and promoting wound healing. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being researched for their potential therapeutic applications.
